title: Fixed finite coefficient coordinates for ordinary exchange and site comparison
statement: Fix a finite-field coefficient datum $(D,C)$ [def-fix-six-functor-datum], a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an integer $n\in\mathbf N$, and put $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ using [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Regard $B$ in the module universe of the small sites, by the canonical universe lift. For a scheme $T$ let $\nu_T^*:D(T_{\mathrm{et}},B)\to D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},B)$ be the canonical exact derived site comparison [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Given $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ and a chosen Cartesian square $s$ [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], define $e_s^{\mathrm{et}}:g^*Rf_*\to Rf'_*g'^*$ on bounded-below etale complexes and $e_s^{\mathrm{proet}}:Lg^*Rf_*\to Rf'_*Lg'^*$ on the ambient derived category to be the published unit--square-comparison--counit mates [def-exchange-projection]. Write $\mathsf C_T=\nu_T^*$, also on bounded-below inputs through their ambient inclusion. If $f$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let $S_{f,g}:\mathsf C_{Y'}(g^*Rf_*(-))\xrightarrow{\sim}Lg^*Rf_*\mathsf C_X(-)$ be the source comparison obtained from the canonical site/direct-image and inverse-image comparisons. If $f'$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let $T_{g',f'}:\mathsf C_{Y'}(Rf'_*g'^*(-))\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*\mathsf C_X(-)$ be the analogous target comparison. These definitions are exactly Coefficient, etaleMate, ambientMate, comparison, sourceIso and targetIso in fixed scalar coordinates; they assume no properness, smoothness or origin witness and assert no invertibility of either exchange.
